patterns.note: Content is organized into distinct 'chapters' with a consistent structure: a small uppercase sans-serif label, a large italicized serif heading, followed by a flexible grid of images and content blocks.
A sophisticated contrast is established between elegant, italicized serif headings for chapter titles and clean, minimalist sans-serif for chapter numbers, captions, and body text.
A dominant, warm off-white background (#F8F7F5) provides a luxurious and airy canvas, allowing high-quality imagery and dark text to stand out with clarity.
As the user scrolls, individual image and content blocks within each chapter subtly fade in and slide upwards as they enter the viewport, creating a gentle reveal effect.
The site employs a strong editorial 'chapter' structure, using numbered headings and distinct visual breaks to guide the user through a narrative brand experience.

technique_notes: The hero section features a full-width video with overlaid text that scrolls away to reveal the main content area, creating an immersive initial experience.
Each major content section is introduced with a small, uppercase sans-serif label and a large, italicized serif heading, establishing a clear narrative hierarchy.

Content cards and images are arranged in a responsive grid and are revealed with a staggered fade-in and slight upward translation animation as they scroll into the user's view, enhancing engagement without being distracting.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, elegant italicized serif headings (~3-4x body text) are paired with small, uppercase sans-serif labels (~0.7x body text) and standard body text, creating a clear hierarchy with significant visual contrast.

standout: The site's distinctive editorial 'chapter' structure transforms a product showcase into a curated, narrative brand experience. This storytelling approach, combined with a warm, off-white background and elegant typography, creates a sophisticated and immersive journey that feels more like a digital magazine than a typical brand website.
